Sections.Name: Heat Haze
Sections.Description: Sunny and cloudy daytime heat shimmer in desert climates, with optional subtropical support.

Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Enable heat haze outdoors in desert climates during sunny or cloudy daytime weather.

Keys.Name: AllowSubtropical
Keys.Description: Also allow heat haze in subtropical climates during sunny or cloudy daytime weather.

Keys.Name: Intensity
Keys.Description: Maximum refraction displacement in screen pixels.

Keys.Name: FullStrengthDistance
Keys.Description: Radius in metres of the world-space haze ring around the player.

Keys.Name: RingHeight
Keys.Description: Total vertical height in metres of the haze ring, including its soft top and bottom fades.

Keys.Name: NoiseScale
Keys.Description: World-space density of the distortion field.
